newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Pakistani plane makes emergency landing in Almaty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani plane makes emergency landing in Almaty.

text.p: A Tupolev-154 passenger plane belonging to Pakistan International Airlines and bound for Islamabad returned to Almaty and made an emergency landing on Monday, an Almaty commercial television channel said.

Almaty 31 television said a fire had broken out aboard the aircraft. The airport information service, which said the plane had returned to Almaty soon after take-off, could not confirm this, saying only there was a technical problem aboard.

An official could not also say how many passengers were aboard. "The only thing we can say at the moment is that the Tupolev is still in the airport and is undergoing a thorough technical examination," he said.

The Tu-154, a three-engined, medium-range passenger plane, is the workhorse of most airlines in the former Soviet Union although some airlines are now switching to Western built Boeing and Airbus jets.
